lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Encik Tanaka, sudah satu tahun Encik bekerja di syarikat kita!
lines.en: Mr Tanaka, you've been working at our company for a year now!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Betul! Satu tahun itu cepat sekali.
lines.en: That's right! The year went by so fast.
choices: Betul! Saya akan bekerja di sini semalam.
Belum! Saya sedang berpindah ke Osaka tahun lepas.
choices_en: That's right! I will work here yesterday.
Not yet! I am moving to Osaka last year.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Bahasa Melayu! Tetapi sekarang saya lebih faham daripada dulu.
lines.en: Malay! But now I understand more than before.
choices: Bahasa Melayu! Tetapi sekarang saya setinggi bahasa Melayu.
Makanan! Saya tidak pernah makan di Malaysia.
choices_en: Malay! But now I'm as tall as Malay.
The food! I've never eaten in Malaysia.

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Ingat hari pertama Encik? Encik tertinggal pasport di dalam teksi!
lines.en: Remember your first day? You left your passport in a taxi!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ya! Pasport itu dihantar ke pejabat oleh pemandu teksi.
lines.en: Yes! The taxi driver brought the passport to the office.

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Pemandu itu sangat baik. Dia tidak minta duit pun.
lines.en: That driver was very kind. He didn't even ask for money.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Saya juga ingat Puan Siti. Dia yang jemput saya ke rumahnya pada hari Ahad pertama.
lines.en: I also remember Mrs Siti. She was the one who invited me to her home on my first Sunday.
choices: Saya juga ingat Puan Siti. Dia dijemput saya ke rumahnya.
Saya juga ingat Puan Siti. Saya yang jemput dia ke Osaka semalam.
choices_en: I also remember Mrs Siti. She was invited me to her home.
I also remember Mrs Siti. I was the one who invited her to Osaka yesterday.

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Bagaimana hidup Encik di sini sekarang?
lines.en: How's life here for you now?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Seronok! Saya bersukan setiap minggu, dan saya sedang belajar memasak.
lines.en: Great! I do sport every week, and I'm learning to cook.
choices: Seronok! Tetapi saya sudah sedang akan belajar memasak.
Seronok! Saya bersukan setiap minggu, tetapi saya tidak suka bersenam.
choices_en: Great! But I already am will learn to cook.
Great! I do sport every week, but I don't like exercising.

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Bagus. Tahun depan, syarikat mahu hantar Encik ke pejabat kita di Ipoh. Encik sudi?
lines.en: Good. Next year the company would like to send you to our office in Ipoh. Would you be willing?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Saya sudi, tetapi saya mesti tanya isteri saya dulu.
lines.en: I'd be glad to, but I have to ask my wife first.
choices: Lain kali, ya? Saya mahu pergi sekarang.
Saya sudi, tetapi Ipoh lebih jauh daripada bulan.
choices_en: Another time? I want to go now.
I'd be glad to, but Ipoh is further than the moon.

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Tidak mengapa. Beritahu saya minggu depan, ya.
lines.en: That's all right. Let me know next week.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Terima kasih banyak, Encik. Satu tahun ini sangat seronok.
lines.en: Thank you very much. This year has been great fun.
